Visakhapatnam's hills, beaches and growing suburbs make it one of the most beautiful places in Andhra Pradesh to build a villa. Building near the sea needs specialist knowledge, though: salt air, heavy rain and humidity test every part of a house.

Manzil Homes is based in Vizag and builds villas as a single design-and-build team, with architecture, structure, construction and interiors all under one roof.

Villa construction in Vizag includes

  • Vastu-aligned planning that makes the most of views
  • Structural design for coastal conditions
  • Waterproofing and corrosion protection
  • Construction with milestone schedules
  • Luxury interiors and outdoor living spaces
  • Transparent BOQs and tracked variations

Building by the sea

Coastal construction needs the right concrete cover, waterproofing and corrosion-resistant reinforcement and fittings. Our engineering-led approach plans for these from the start.

We design villas to capture sea and hill views from the rooms you use most, while managing afternoon sun and monsoon rain.
